title: Official MCP stdio adapter
description: Objective: expose generated safe commands and queries through the official stable MCP TypeScript SDK over stdio. Deliverable: packages/mcp stdio modules and protocol fixtures. NOT in scope: lifecycle logic, custom WebSocket MCP, or IDE-specific behavior. Hard dependency: stable generated daemon contracts. Owned paths: packages/mcp/src/stdio/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/mcp test.
definitionOfDone: Tool schemas are generated and bounded; authentication/capability checks match HTTP.
Command IDs, stable errors, truth, cursors, and recovery commands preserve parity.
Malformed, oversized, stale, and disconnected clients fail closed.
taskRails: Portability consumes frozen daemon/core contracts; adapters cannot fork lifecycle or authority semantics.
Official MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP only; no custom MCP-over-WebSocket dialect.
Unsupported OS/provider/import facts remain typed UNSUPPORTED or UNKNOWN, never guessed.
IDE adapters are thin optional shells for the standalone control room. Keep files below 400 lines and use explicit owned paths.
